# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 7 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** God's Mercy on Israel in Exile

---

**7:1** Do not let your dwelling be far from us, O God;
lest those who hate us without cause come against us.

**7:2** Have you rejected us? No — do not reject us, O God!
For what cause would you turn your face away from us?

**7:3** Then the nations will trample us in arrogance
and there will be none to deliver us.

**7:4** But you are our God from the beginning,
and our hope is fixed in you, O LORD.

**7:5** We will not abandon your covenant;
we will not turn our heart away from you.

**7:6** Your mercy is upon us, O LORD our God;
your mercy upon the people of Israel forever.

**7:7** For you have scattered us among the nations for our transgressions;
yet you have not forsaken us entirely.

**7:8** For you are our protector, O God;
when we call upon you, hear us.

**7:9** For you are merciful to the house of Jacob,
and you will not hide your face from them.

**7:10** What nation is so great as you?
Or who has a God so near and faithful as the LORD our God?

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal English rendering following Greek syntax. Poetic lineation preserved.*
